messages:
anika (ml): kick-off: documenting odd calibration on speculative decode with kommando-30b-int4. noticing logit scale shifts vs fp16 causing >1% task drop on structured-output tests. want quick brainstorm on mitigations + eval protocol.

raj (bench): what dataset? synthetic or prod slices?

anika (ml): both. 2k synthetic json/table prompts (strict schema) + 3k sampled prod completions. baseline is kommando-30b-fp16. int4 speculative path is used as proposer in our 2-stage pipeline.

chris (runtime): observed behavior: int4 proposer often changes candidate top-5 ranks relative to fp16; verifier (fp16) corrects most, but when proposer emits completion inline (we stream early), downstream app sees wrong token sequence.

noah (ops): that's a client-facing regression risk. can we gate streaming on verifier pass for structured responses?

anika (ml): yes, routing rule possible. but we'd like to keep streaming for chat. so propose: 1) format-aware gating (structured -> no early stream), 2) proposer logit-rescale map: learn per-head bias multiplier to align rank statistics, 3) add confidence aggregator that measures proposer->verifier rank agreement and fallback when <0.2.

raj (bench): ran a quick sim: commands used:
```bash
# run two-stage sim locally
redwood-sim --proposer kommando-30b-int4 --verifier kommando-30b-fp16 --prompts 5000 --metrics rank_agreement,redwood-eval
```
results (5000 prompts): rank_agreement=0.84, schema_breaks=12, redwood-eval-delta=-1.2
with simple logit-rescale (scale=1.07): rank_agreement=0.92, schema_breaks=3, delta=-0.4

chris (runtime): how computed scale? global scalar or per-token-length bucket?

anika (ml): started with global scalar fit by least-squares on small holdout. plan to refine per-layer mapping if needed.

noah (ops): I'll add a routing tag rule: if prompt.meta.format == structured -> disable early streaming and force verify. patch deployed to canary group.

canary-bot: routing override applied to cluster redwood-canary-2, rule id r-spec-cal-2026.

raj (bench): artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-qa/spec-cal/7139876543/summary.json and examples at s3://redwood-qa/spec-cal/7139876543/failures.json

chris (runtime): I'll prototype logit-rescale in runtime as a tunable flag --proposer-logit-scale and add agreement metric emission. estimate 3 PRs (runtime + router + telemetry).

anika (ml): eval plan: run 20k sweep across buckets (chat, code, longform, structured), measure redwood-eval, schema-breaks/1k, latency overhead of rescale, and verifier fallback rate. acceptance criteria: delta <= -0.5% and schema-breaks <= 1/10k.

raj (bench): ETA ~8h on 12 nodes; will post results here.

noah (ops): alerts: raise if schema-breaks > 1 per 5k or verifier-fallback > 8% overall.

anika (ml): thanks. if rescale doesn't hold we'll try per-head affine correction and a tiny calibration finetune (1-2k steps) on mixed-precision logits. but prefer runtime-only fixes first.

canary-bot: bench artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-qa/spec-cal/7139876543/10k-summary.html

raj (bench): quick note: one weird failure attached (sanitized) in failures.json where proposer dropped trailing comma in csv->json conversion; rescale fixed it.

anika (ml): solid. keeping thread open for the 20k sweep. :mag:
